title: Analysis code and subject-level data for: Abstract representations of sensorimotor transformations in human premotor cortex
description:
Data and analysis code accompanying Kang, Trach, & McDougle, Abstract representations of sensorimotor transformations in human premotor cortex. The numbered scripts in analysis_pipeline/ reproduce every statistic reported in the paper from the subject-level data included here; analysis_pipeline/subject_level/ and image_processing_pipeline/ document the cluster pipeline that produced that data from the raw images.

Code is released under the MIT License; the data files under data/ are released under CC0.
